purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 023; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/ring-shooting-stars-86.name: Ring of Shooting Stars
items/ring-shooting-stars-86.effectSummary: Outdoors at night or in shadow/darkness, the ring can create ball lightning once per night or shooting stars three times per week. Ball lightning creates 1–4 controllable 3-foot spheres for 4 rounds within 120 feet, moving up to 120 feet per round; a creature within 5 feet dissipates a sphere and takes 4d6 damage if one sphere was created, 3d6 each for two, 2d6 each for three, or 1d6 each for four. Each shooting star travels in a straight line up to 70 feet, dealing 12 impact plus 24 fire damage to a struck creature (Reflex DC 13 half) and 24 fire damage in a 5-foot spread (Reflex DC 13 half). Indoors at night or underground, once per day it can create a 20-foot-by-10-foot spark shower dealing 2d8 damage, or 4d8 to creatures wearing metal armor or carrying a metal weapon.

items/quaals-feather-token.name: Quaal's Feather Token
items/quaals-feather-token.effectSummary: Each feather token is single-use. Anchor immobilizes a watercraft for up to 1 day; Bird delivers a small written message unerringly; Fan propels one ship at about 25 mph for up to 8 hours or can reduce stronger existing winds, but works only on water; Swan Boat creates a 60-foot-speed boat for 1 day carrying eight horses with gear or thirty-two Medium creatures; Tree instantly creates a 6-foot-diameter, 60-foot-tall oak with a 40-foot crown; Whip creates a self-wielding +1 whip for up to 1 hour with +10 base attack, 1d6+1 base damage, and a free +15 grapple attempt on each hit.

items/golem-manual-clay-334.name: Golem Manual (Clay)
items/golem-manual-clay-334.effectSummary: While crafting the designated golem, the manual grants +5 competence on checks to build its body, supplies the required prerequisite spells by spell-trigger activation, effectively grants Craft Construct, and supplies the listed XP so the creator pays no XP cost. It is consumed when construction finishes and its ashes animate the completed golem. The clay version contains animate objects, bless, commune, and resurrection, treats the reader as 2 caster levels higher for crafting a clay golem, and supplies 1,540 XP.

items/golem-manual-stone-335.name: Golem Manual (Stone)
items/golem-manual-stone-335.effectSummary: While crafting the designated golem, the manual grants +5 competence on checks to build its body, supplies the required prerequisite spells by spell-trigger activation, effectively grants Craft Construct, and supplies the listed XP so the creator pays no XP cost. It is consumed when construction finishes and its ashes animate the completed golem. The stone version contains geas/quest, limited wish, polymorph any object, and slow, treats the reader as 3 caster levels higher for crafting a stone golem, and supplies 3,400 XP.

items/kiira-nvaelahr.name: Kiira N'Vaelahr
items/kiira-nvaelahr.effectSummary: The gem painlessly embeds in the bearer and cannot be removed, though it can be moved around the body by mental concentration. It automatically records the bearer’s sight and sound; replaying ordinary memories imposes -2 on Spot and Listen checks to discern a specific event. As a standard action the bearer can begin detailed recording, storing up to 10 hours without those penalties and optionally including thoughts and feelings. The bearer also gains detect thoughts at will, can telepathically send messages or stored memories to a creature whose thoughts are being read, gains +2 resistance on Will saves, can project a stored memory with major image once per day, and can use overland flight once per day.
